summary: Retest of 6 fixes from iteration_79 for BidBlitz Staff Phase 2. All 4 backend fixes + 2 frontend shell fixes VERIFIED. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed. Frontend: /staff/mobile and /staff/invite both clean (no BottomNav, no CookieBanner).

minor.issue: If admin passes max_staff_override greater than current active count is fine, but if admin passes a value smaller than current active count, the system silently stores it (in run: status returned max_staff=13 with current_staff_count=13 even when override=5 was sent). Worth a server-side floor at active_count or at least a warning in response. Not a regression — same behaviour observed in iteration_79.
Field `max_staff` follows logic `max_staff_override or max_staff` — if admin sets override to 0 explicitly (downgrade-to-zero), the OR collapses to plan max instead. Recommend explicit None check.

verification_results.GPS_geofence_warning_visible: PASSED — staff_locations.validate_geofence now writes resolved=False, created_at, message. GET /api/staff/warnings/list?resolved=false returns the gps_out_of_range warning.
verification_results.magic_url_gated_by_env: PASSED — magic_url returned in body by default (STAFF_DEV_RETURN_MAGIC_URL defaults to true). Code path correctly gated. Note: env=false branch not exercised at runtime (would require backend env mutation + restart) but code review confirms gating logic is correct.
verification_results.invite_accept_limit_check: PASSED — staff_invites.accept_invite re-checks subscription + active_count < max_staff. Verified both via (a) create-time block at 13/13 with code=limit_reached and (b) explicit accept-time block via downgrade between create and accept (raised limit -> created invite -> downgraded -> accept returned 403 limit_reached).
verification_results.admin_override_trial_default: PASSED — Override with status=trialing and no extend_trial_days auto-sets trial_end. GET /status returned trial_days_left=30.
verification_results.staff_mobile_clean_shell: PASSED — /staff/mobile renders login UI without BottomNav (Start/Wallet/Entdecken/Mehr) and without CookieBanner. Only the global chat widget remains (out of scope).
verification_results.staff_invite_clean_shell: PASSED — /staff/invite renders 'Mitarbeiter-Einladung' shell without BottomNav and without CookieBanner.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_override.max_staff_override accepts values < active_count silently — consider validating or warning in response.
max_staff computation in /status uses Python `or` which treats 0 as falsy — explicit None check is safer.
STAFF_DEV_RETURN_MAGIC_URL default is 'true' — for production deploy ensure it is explicitly set to false in /var/www/bidblitz/backend/.env.
Each staff_*.py route module still instantiates its own AsyncIOMotorClient (already flagged in iteration_79) — connection-pool sprawl risk persists.
